background_image_description: Textured blue sky backdrop with subtle film grain and scattered soft white cumulus clouds, denser at the lower-left and mid-right; gentle vertical gradient from deeper azure at the top to slightly lighter blue toward the bottom.

nodes.asset_description: Overhead photo of an open Bible centered on the canvas. The book shows two pages of dense black text in two columns with small headings; cream-colored pages with slightly darker edges and a black cover visible at left and right. The book is photographed on transparent background with no visible shadow.

nodes.svg_description: Hand-drawn white oval ring encircling the word 'GOD'; slightly irregular, double-stroked look with open ends overlapping at the right side.
Short hand-drawn white swoosh underline beneath the word 'WORD'; slightly curved upward in the middle with tapered ends.
